hook.name: UnbridgedBeacon
hook.description: A hook for the canonical ETH/UNBRIDGED pool that records a rolling keccak commitment of all swaps and liquidity events (the "signal root") at storage slot 0, enabling trustless ZK storage-proof cross-chain state verification. Enforces a harbormaster-gated trading launch with a fee that decays linearly from 25% to 1% over ~300 blocks after opening.
